title: merge-queue.yml
description: How goat-merge runs the queue for a branch. Without this file the queue follows the repository's own rules.

version.description: The shape of this file. Only 1 exists.

queues.description: One entry per branch that has a queue. A branch that is not listed is not managed.

branch.description: The branch being merged into, for example main.

enqueue.description: manual waits for the merge-queue label. automatic queues a pull request as soon as it is ready.

merge_method.description: Required only when the repository allows more than one. goat-merge will not guess which history you want.

mode.description: How candidates are verified. Serial is one at a time, and is the only mode today.

check_timeout.description: How long to wait for a candidate's checks before giving up, written as a number and s, m or h.

ci_failures.description: How many times to re-run a candidate whose checks failed before the pull request leaves the queue. Retrying forever hides flaky tests and spends CI, so the default is not to.
